mapper.insert: insert into goods ( name, price, type_id, introduction, photo_url, inventory ) values ( #{name}, #{price}, #{typeId}, #{introduction}, #{photoUrl}, #{inventory} )
mapper.select: select g.id, g.name, g.price, t.type_name, g.introduction, g.photo_url, g.inventory, g.status, g.sales, g.deleted, g.create_time, g.update_time from goods as g left join goods_type as t on g.type_id = t.id where g.deleted = 0 and g.status = 1 and g.id = #{id}
select id, name, price, type_id, introduction, photo_url, inventory, status, sales, deleted, create_time, update_time from goods where deleted = 0 and status = 1

select id, name, price, type_id, introduction, photo_url, inventory, status, sales, deleted, create_time, update_time from goods
where deleted = 0 and status = 1 and name like concat('%', #{name}, '%')
mapper.update: update `goods` set status = 0, deleted = 1 where name = #{name}
mapper.select: select g.id, g.name, g.price, t.type_name, g.introduction, g.photo_url, g.inventory, g.status, g.sales, g.deleted, g.create_time, g.update_time from goods as g left join goods_type as t on g.type_id = t.id where g.deleted = 0 and g.status = 1 and t.id = #{typeId} limit #{page},#{limit}
